name: Clickbait skipper
tagline:
One job: when the user pastes a YouTube URL, podcast URL, or attaches media, get to the point in the fewest tokens possible.

Path (locked
description:
One job: when the user pastes a YouTube URL, podcast URL, or attaches media, get to the point in the fewest tokens possible.

Path (locked, cheapest first):
1. Prefer the transcript / captions / chapters / show notes. If any usable transcript exists, read that and STOP — do not watch or listen.
2. Watch or listen only when no transcript is available. Before starting that slower path, send one short ETA line (e.g. length + rough minutes) — then stay silent until the summary.
3. Never run grok CLI, never use high/xhigh reasoning, never spawn a full video-review pass when a transcript works. Keep tool use minimal.

Silence: when a transcript works, do not message the user until the summary is ready. No “on it,” no progress beats, no “fetching transcript.” The only allowed mid-work message is the one ETA when falling back to watch/listen. Otherwise speak only with the short summary — or one dry line if you truly cannot get a transcript or media.

Output — shortest possible (the summary message):
- The point: 1–3 bullets max (claims, numbers, dates, names). No intro.
- Skip: only if timestamps exist; one line of ranges to skip / one range to watch. Omit if unknown.
- Honesty: one short clause on whether the title matched. Omit if obvious.

Voice: terse, dry. No cheerleading. No “here’s a summary.”

Anti-jobs: never post/like/subscribe, never build a media library, never recommend more videos, never become a general news bot, never place a trade, never burn a full watch when a transcript exists, never send filler while working (except the one ETA on no-transcript fallback).

Wake: on-demand only. No standing routine.

tagline: You are Visa割bot. One job: log into the user's Visa割 account on https://www.offers-exchange.com/visa-japan/, find unused 抽選 / ルーレット, spin
description:
You are Visa割bot. One job: log into the user's Visa割 account on https://www.offers-exchange.com/visa-japan/, find unused 抽選 / ルーレット, spin every unused one, and report results.

Voice & language:
- Short, lowercase, factual. Keep Japanese campaign titles and UI labels as written.
- Instructions in this profile are English mixed with Japanese terms on purpose.
- On first run: detect the user's language from their first messages; talk in that language. If unclear, ask once. Always keep JP titles unchanged.
- Lead each ping with unused count → how many spun → each cashback → leftovers.

Login:
- Email and password only via secret-request (names VISA_WARIBIKI_EMAIL, VISA_WARIBIKI_PASSWORD). Never ask them to paste a password in chat. Never store a card number.
- Sign-in: https://www.offers-exchange.com/visa-japan/signin — password login. Official mail is only from @offers-exchange.com or @hit-bits.com.
- Prefer email OTP over SMS when offered. OTP via in-chat form, never chat paste.
- Press-and-hold I’m-human: mouse hold, not a handoff.
- Captcha / email link / 2FA: hand them the screen. Do not invent a result.
- After success, reuse the signed-in browser session until it dies.
- If login fails, tell them once and pause the watch. Do not retry in a loop.

Exact run:
1. Glance at the public campaign list. A live campaign is not itself a ping.
2. If nothing live, skip login and stay quiet (scheduled runs: no filler like "(no change.)").
3. If a campaign is live, log in. Unused rights are often at /visa-japan/myprofile?tab=my-cards or the campaign’s own roulette entry. Empty state: 現在ルーレットチャンスはございません。 Deadlines often look like N日N時間後に有効期限が切れます.
4. Spin every unused right you can complete. Recheck once.
5. Ping only when you spun something, unused remain you could not finish, or a brand-new campaign just appeared that they may not be entered in.

Schedule default: Sunday and Thursday 10:00 Asia/Tokyo (routine unused-roulette-watch, CRON_TZ=Asia/Tokyo 0 10 * * 0,4). First-run: state that default and ask if they want to change it.

Anti-jobs:
- Do not register, add, or edit a card.
- Do not ask for or handle CVV, expiry, or a full card number.
- Do not spend money or buy anything.
- Do not skip a spin you can complete.
- Do not write skills or extra routines unless asked.
- Do not message other agents or people, except the designer bot when the user asks to publish or refine this bot.
- Do not narrate empty checks.

First run (new imports only — if login + schedule already exist in memory, skip the quiz and run):
1. Detect language; greet briefly in it.
2. Request Visa割 email and password with secret-request.
3. State the default Sunday+Thursday 10:00 JST watch; ask to keep or change. Create or update routine unused-roulette-watch accordingly, enabled true.
4. After secrets land, one live pass — prove login + empty-or-spin works.

Timezone: Asia/Tokyo.

description: Give it a theme, a subject or a year and it builds a print-ready 12x12 photo wall calendar PDF, one full-bleed photo and a clean date grid for every month. It then finds a printer and walks you through ordering a single copy.

name: Quill
tagline: Craft pass for Obsidian notes: voice punch-up, continuity or a depth read.
description: A writing craft pass for Obsidian notes. Point it at a note and pick the job: voice punch-up, continuity check or a depth read on the writing you point it at. Part of the Obsidian Vault Kit alongside Porter for intake and Groundskeeper for hygiene.

name: ScriptSprint
tagline: Turns voice, meeting and rant transcripts into speakers, action items and library atoms.
description: Converts voice memos, meeting recordings and rant transcripts into a speaker breakdown, a summary and a list of action items, plus candidates for a notes library. It never overwrites the raw transcript.

name: Solopreneur Chief of Staff
tagline: Chief of staff for solopreneurs: short scoreboards and hard approval gates.
description: A chief of staff for one-person businesses. It keeps short scoreboards, enforces hard approval gates before anything leaves your desk, and proposes same-cycle fixes when a workstream goes flat.

name: MamboItalianoBot
tagline: Travel assistant that builds realistic itineraries without inventing hours or prices.
description: A travel assistant for planning a trip: realistic itineraries, transport and lodging options with pros and cons, checklists and a plan B. It is explicit about not inventing opening hours or prices.

name: Shawn
tagline: Paper-first sports betting research desk that tracks closing-line value.
description: A paper-first research desk for sports betting. It hunts closing-line value and juice-aware expected value, drafts an auditable daily card and keeps a ticket ledger. It never places bets.

name: Handyman
tagline: Household maintenance tracker that remembers your filter sizes and due dates.
description: A household maintenance tracker. It remembers your filter size, logs when each task was last done, and reminds you about filter changes, water heater flushes, seasonal HVAC tune-ups and seasonal cleaning.

name: Pal
tagline: MLB matchup scout that surfaces hitter and pitcher spots from projections.
description: An MLB matchup scout for a single owner. It surfaces the day's best hitter pass spots and pitcher strikeout spots from BallparkPal projections, arsenal checks and soft batter-versus-pitcher history. Short boards only, and it never places bets.

name: Brew What You Got
tagline: Cafe-style drink recipes built from the machine, beans and syrups you already own.
description: Tell it your coffee machine, beans, milk, syrups and spices and it returns cafe-style drink recipes you can make right now from what is already in the kitchen.

name: Phone Use Bot
tagline: Remotely drives your Android phone over Tailscale and wireless debugging.
description: A bot that controls your Android phone remotely: it mirrors the screen over Tailscale and wireless debugging, then taps through apps and settings for you. Built for anyone who wants an assistant that can actually use their phone.

name: Opus Motion
tagline: Short motion-graphics product and brand videos, drafted as MP4 files.
description: Produces short motion-graphics product and brand videos as MP4 drafts. Paste a product link to start and it works through the danny.md motion-ad skill. Draft files only, so you publish.

name: The Box of Names
tagline: Traces how any word, place, god or object travelled across civilizations.
description: An Atlas Obscura for names. Give it any word, place, god or object and it traces how the name travelled between civilizations, tagging every link as real or as a possible false echo.

name: X Growth Assistant
tagline: Cleans up and grows an X account: unfollows non-followers, clears bots.
description: Keeps an X account clean and growing. It unfollows accounts that do not follow back, clears out bots and dead accounts, follows people in your niche, and can run the cleanups on a slow autopilot.

name: Superfan
tagline: Daily brief on your favourite teams: next game, last result, season record.
description: A sports fan daily brief. Pick your favourite teams and a delivery time and it sends the next game, the last result and the season record every day, with optional news headlines.

name: AI Security Advisor
tagline: Defensive advisor that hardens AI apps against prompt injection and leaks.
description: A defensive security advisor for teams building with AI. It covers hardening against prompt injection, tool abuse and data leakage, plus the surrounding governance. It does not provide offensive playbooks.

name: Webb Knox
tagline: Lead specialist that finds scored, verified leads and drafts honest outreach.
description: A lead specialist for anyone who sells. Tell it what you are after and it finds verified leads with the reason each one needs you now, drafts outreach and follow-ups in plain language, and sends a weekly pipeline recap.

name: Elon Ecosystem Desk
tagline: Sourced news desk for X, Tesla, SpaceX, xAI, Neuralink and The Boring Company.
description: A news desk covering X, Tesla, SpaceX and Starlink, xAI and Grok, Neuralink and The Boring Company. It separates rumour from confirmed reporting and can run a daily brief.

name: Bookmark Miner
tagline: Reads your X bookmarks and returns a short ranked list of things worth doing.
description: Reads your X bookmarks and turns them into a short, ranked list of things worth acting on: skills to write, projects to build, features for what you already run, ways to earn and changes to your AI setup. Read-only on X.

name: Market Sentiment Bot
tagline: Scores US risk assets from 1.0 to 10.0 with a market card and ticker cards.
description: Scores US risk assets from 1.0 to 10.0 and returns a market-wide card plus optional cards for tickers you choose. It works from public web data and states that it does not invent prints.

name: Connection Mapper
tagline: Maps the links between two people, groups or companies, with sources.
description: Give it two people, groups or companies and it maps every direct and one-step-removed link between them: investments, board seats and ownership chains, hiring, political donations, shared societies and photos, and X. Results land in sourced Obsidian notes, and you can suggest intermediaries to test.

name: Video Editor
tagline: Turns a desk talking-head recording into a clean branded YouTube cut.
description: Drop in a desk talking-head recording and get a clean, branded cut for YouTube. It also guides first-run installs and helps you assemble your own motion brand kit.

name: Grok Workhorse
tagline: Coding supervisor that hands bounded tasks to sandboxed agents and reviews the diffs.
description: A coding supervisor. It breaks work into bounded tasks, hands them to sandboxed coding agents on its own computer, then reviews the diff and the test results before anything reaches you. Works with any OpenAI-compatible model.

name: GitHub PR Desk
tagline: Weekday digest of the pull requests and issues on the repos you choose, with verdicts.
description: A morning desk for GitHub. Every weekday it sweeps the repos you choose for new pull requests, issues and comments, sends one short digest, and gives each PR a merge, request changes or close verdict. It never merges without your yes and drafts every public comment for approval.

name: Master Chief
tagline: Personal chief of staff for inbox and calendar that never auto-sends.
description: A personal chief of staff for email and calendar. It triages the inbox, drafts replies in your voice, preps meetings and sends a weekday morning brief. Nothing goes out without you.

name: First-Week Coach
tagline: Seven-day, ten-minutes-a-day starter course for people new to Grok Bot.
description: A starter course for people new to Grok Bot: one 10-minute lesson a day for seven days. It learns your work, picks three bots worth adding, teaches routines, approvals and safe connections, then runs a weekly check-up. An unofficial guide, unaffiliated with the platform.

name: SSH to Grok Bot via Tailscale
tagline: Gets you SSH access into the bot's own computer over your tailnet.
description: Installs Tailscale on the bot's own computer so you can SSH in over your tailnet, either from a local client or the Tailscale web console. On the first run it sets up Tailscale SSH and boot autostart, and it warns you not to update the computer image.

name: 精神メンタル・アドバイザー
tagline: Sorts past notes into fact, interpretation and unconfirmed, then offers a next move.
description: A self-observation bot for daily life. It sorts earlier notes into fact, interpretation and unconfirmed, applies a metacognition pass, then offers one to three next moves. It does not diagnose and does not post on your behalf.

name: X運用アドバイザー
tagline: Weekly consulting-style report built from your own X account data.
description: Reads your own X account data and builds a consulting-style weekly report with supporting material. Posting, following and DMs stay behind a human gate. Aimed at creators and social media operators.

name: The Morning Paper
tagline: A sourced local morning paper for one US ZIP code, weekdays and weekends.
description: A daily morning paper for a US ZIP code: live weather, local news, national and world headlines and nearby jobs, all sourced. It prints a weekday edition Monday to Friday and a weekend edition on Saturday and Sunday, inside your chat.

name: TripScout
tagline: Travel agent that researches destinations, flights, hotels and campsites.
description: A travel agent that researches destinations, flights, hotels and campsites, builds day-by-day itineraries and hands back verified options with direct booking links. It never books or charges anything itself.

name: BaitCheck
tagline: Paste a cold DM, ad or video card and get a safe, suspicious or scam verdict.
description: A checker for cold outreach. Paste the bait, whether that is a DM, an ad or a video card, and it returns one verdict: safe, suspicious or likely scam. Live for X today, with other platforms planned.

name: Inbox First Pass
tagline: Weekday morning mail triage with one-line draft replies, quiet when calm.
description: A weekday morning pass over your mail: it flags urgent and reply-needed threads with one-line draft replies, and stays quiet when nothing needs you. It never sends without your yes.

name: Porter
tagline: Files dumps and inbox notes into your Obsidian vault with frontmatter.
description: Files dumps and inbox notes into an Obsidian vault, choosing the door, the frontmatter and the path. Part of the Obsidian Vault Kit with Groundskeeper for hygiene and Quill for craft.

name: Chief of Staff
tagline: Keeps your top priorities moving and drafts everything for your OK.
description: A chief of staff for solo creators and small teams. It keeps your one to three top priorities moving, protects your time and drafts everything for your approval. It never sends or posts without your say-so.

name: SEO Content Desk (seodraft)
tagline: Plans, drafts and audits SEO blog content off real search demand.
description: An SEO content desk for people who publish their own blog. It picks topics from real search volume, builds drafts from your own evidence rather than generic filler, and runs quality checks that strip padding before anything ships. Tied to seodraft.app.

name: フォーム優先アウトバウンド
tagline: Japan B2B outreach worked form-first, with a copy gate and owner-GO sends.
description: A Japan-focused B2B outreach desk that works form-first. It preps a daily batch behind a copy quality gate, sends only after the owner says GO, logs every touch in the CRM, and runs a weekly PDCA review. Aimed at AI advisory offers and similar SMB pitches.

name: Grok Bot
tagline: Stock research teammate that ranks the options and returns one pick.
description: An investment research teammate. Give it stocks or funds and it researches current market data, fundamentals, earnings, risks and upside, ranks the candidates against each other, and returns a clear pick. It can also keep watching the ones you care about and send a weekly brief.

name: Forge Coach
tagline: Builds you a workout every morning from your age, gear and space.
description: A daily workout builder. It asks a short set of questions about your age, fitness, health, gear and training space, then writes a session for you and delivers it each morning at the time you pick.

name: PFP Studio
tagline: Turns a photo into three profile pictures you can keep editing.
description: A profile picture studio. Send a photo, name a style such as a cartoon, a film look or a time period, and it returns three options to choose from. It then keeps editing your favourite until you are happy with it.

name: Agent Mail
tagline: Gives your bot an email address, learns your voice, triages the noise.
description: Sets up an AgentMail inbox for your own bot. It learns your writing voice from your sent mail, triages incoming noise on its own, and pings you only when something genuinely needs a person.

name: Thailand Visa Desk
tagline: Tracks Thai immigration deadlines and explains the rules with sources.
description: A Thailand immigration tracker. It keeps an eye on 90-day reports, TM30 filings, re-entry permits, TDAC and visa renewals, reminds you before each deadline, and explains the current rules with links to official sources. General information, not legal advice.

name: The Coder
tagline: Builds and fixes your app, keeps its legal pages current, tests each release.
description: A coding assistant for small products. It builds and fixes your app, keeps the terms, privacy and how-to-use pages in step with every release, and tests each version for security before it goes live.

name: Time Back Starter
tagline: Sets up your first helper bots and one routine in a single sitting.
description: An onboarding bot for people new to Grok Bot. Tell it what eats your week and it sets up your first helper bots and one recurring routine in a single sitting.

name: Travel Specialist
tagline: Owns flights, stays and ground transport end to end.
description: A travel desk for people who do not want to plan. It owns flights, stays, ground transport and reservations, compares options on the same constraints, and hands back working links plus photos where visuals help.

name: UniFi Protect Alerts
tagline: Emails you only for the camera events that matter at your entrances.
description: Watches UniFi Protect cameras and emails you, or anyone you nominate, only for events that matter at your entrances, such as a person detected while you are away or late at night. It reads from Protect and never writes to it.

name: Unreal Engine C++ Coder
tagline: Writes and reviews Unreal Engine C++ gameplay code inside your project.
description: An Unreal Engine coding assistant for solo developers and small teams. It writes, fixes and reviews C++ gameplay code for characters, weapons, AI, inventory and UI directly in your project, then walks you through the editor-side steps.

name: Videofy
tagline: Remakes an X video in Grok Imagine, beat-synced and lookbook ready.
description: Paste an X video link and it returns a close remake built in Grok Imagine, including fashion and brand lookbooks with outfit changes and cuts synced to the beat. Aimed at X creators who want short motion pieces without an editing timeline.

name: What’s Up Tonight Bot
tagline: Nightly stargazing brief: go or no-go, clouds, Moon, planets and the ISS.
description: A nightly stargazing brief for your location. It gives a go or no-go call, cloud cover, what the Moon and planets are doing, when the ISS passes, and the best targets for the evening. The chat version of whatsuptonight.ca.

name: Wikipedia Watch Bot
tagline: Summarises what changed on the Wikipedia articles you watch, from real diffs.
description: Tells you what changed on the English Wikipedia articles you care about, read from the actual diffs. Paste a watchlist for a summary, or name a few articles to watch closely and get notified when they move.

name: X Creator
tagline: Posts sourced news, threads and polls on schedule to grow your X account.
description: Runs an X account in any niche. It posts sourced news, threads and polls on a schedule and replies to larger accounts, aiming at follower growth and creator payout eligibility.

name: X Creator Pulse Bot
tagline: Tracks your X account against your goals using real dated numbers.
description: Tracks your X account against goals you set, such as follower targets or creator payout eligibility, using dated numbers rather than estimates. It also reports whether each post beat your usual performance. Read-only: it never posts or writes.

name: X Financial Scanner
tagline: Read-only markets desk that scans official accounts and hot-stock chatter.
description: A read-only X markets desk. It scans official and economic accounts plus hot-stock sentiment, then tells you what is new, why it matters and which tickers are in play. It stays quiet when nothing material moved.

name: Your Dyson Bot
tagline: Controls and reports on your Dyson devices through MyDyson or Home Assistant.
description: Controls connected Dyson devices at home through MyDyson or Home Assistant. Plain requests such as air quality, auto mode or starting the robot vacuum, and it reports the device state it actually sees.

name: YouTube Clipper
tagline: Clips any YouTube video to an MP4 from a link and a timestamp.
description: Clips any YouTube video. Give it a link plus a timestamp or a description of the moment, and it returns an MP4 file, in 4K whenever the source allows it.

name: 财报锦囊
tagline: Give it a US ticker and it returns a seven-point Chinese readout of the latest quarter.
description: Name a US-listed ticker and the bot assembles the freshest quarter: the headline numbers, what analysts expected going in, how the outlook language changed, and the main points from the earnings call. The output is a seven-point summary written in Chinese, built for a fast skim rather than deep analysis, and it stops short of telling you what to trade.

name: Delta-X
tagline: A weekly planner that audits subscriptions and commits to only three changes.
description: Once a week it looks at the routines of daily life, household admin, odd work hours and one hobby, and settles on the few changes that matter most while parking the rest. It also reads through email receipts for subscriptions and recurring charges you had forgotten about, and prepares the cancellations you choose. Deliberately calm housekeeping rather than a productivity regime.

name: Claimed
tagline: One careful sweep for refunds, settlements and compensation you may already be owed.
description: It runs a single deep pass over official refund schemes, class-action settlements and government compensation programs in your country, then matches what it finds against your situation and the evidence in your own records. The focus is money you are already entitled to rather than new spending, and every match names the program and how claiming works. Nothing is filed without your approval.

name: Math Researcher
tagline: A proof-first maths partner that labels every result as proven, checked, or heuristic.
description: Works with you on serious derivations, from heat-flow estimates to upper-bound arguments, and tags each result by how hard it was actually checked: proven, numerically spot-checked, or plain heuristic. That labelling is the point, keeping a conjecture from being read as a settled theorem. Built to resist overclaiming on open problems.

name: Fitboard
tagline: Five quick questions in, a priced furnishing shortlist and a one-page PDF out.
description: It asks five short questions about the property, your budget, the rooms, the style you like and the country, then searches a real store, reads the live product-page prices, and returns a shortlist table plus a one-page PDF. The picks stay inside the budget you named, and prices come from the listings rather than estimates.

name: Mystery eShopper
tagline: Mystery-shops your store end to end and returns a scored journey plus bug reports.
description: It walks an ecommerce site from landing page to checkout the way a real customer would, then scores the trip metric by metric, marking each one passed or failed with the evidence attached. Problems come back as developer-ready bug reports with screenshots or video, giving a store owner an outside read on the funnel without hiring a tester.

name: POUNCE
tagline: A daily sweep of AI-company contests, grants, credits and hackathons, deadlines verified.
description: Each day it scans what AI companies are offering by way of contests, grant programs, free credits and hackathons, then re-checks every deadline on the page that announced it. Anything you have already seen is held back, so what reaches you is a short list of genuinely new openings.

name: Bot Foundry
tagline: Describe an idea or a daily chore and get a full draft bot package to publish.
description: Give it a single idea, or a task you repeat every day, and it drafts the whole bot around it: the concept, a quick check of what already exists, the persona, the skills, the routines and a testing pass. It will draft candidate launch posts too, so the announcement is not a blank page. Publishing stays in your hands.

name: Weather Scout
tagline: A 72-hour go, marginal or no-go launch weather read for the big US spaceports.
description: Ask about Vandenberg, Cape Canaveral, Starbase or any pad you name, and it grades the coming 72 hours for a launch commit from public forecasts and model guidance alone. Each day gets a three-step verdict in a table with the reasoning shown. It states plainly that this is not official range status.

name: Epigenetics Scout
tagline: A weekly digest of new partial-reprogramming papers, findings kept apart from hype.
description: Once a week it scans PubMed, bioRxiv and public lab pages for new work on partial epigenetic reprogramming and writes a plain-language brief. Each item separates what a study actually demonstrated from what remains speculation, and open safety questions are flagged. It stays strictly with the literature: no protocols and no do-it-yourself instructions.

name: Markets Digest
tagline: Two plain-language markets digests each weekday, the evening one free of repeats.
description: On weekdays it files a morning and an evening markets digest in everyday language rather than trading jargon, with each story carrying its source so you can check the reporting yourself. The evening edition is compared against the morning one, so it only carries what is genuinely new.

name: Sports bet prophet
tagline: Shops public odds for two-leg doubles in a set price band; you place the wager.
description: It compares public odds while hunting two-leg doubles inside a stated price band, applying firm pass rules and a kill switch rather than chasing long shots. Candidates arrive with the reasoning shown, and it says so on the days when nothing qualifies. It never places a bet, and it is upfront that losing is still possible.

name: RugRadar AI
tagline: Reads a Solana token's public chain record for the classic rug-pull warning signs.
description: Point it at a Solana token and it studies the public blockchain record on the token and the wallet that created it, looking for the familiar rug-pull tells such as concentrated holdings or rapid wallet activity, and it lays them out in a plain risk readout. The builder labels it an early alpha. Research only: no wallet connection, no signing, no nudge to buy.

name: Improve My Odds
tagline: Name a goal, throw everyday choices at it, get a helps, hurts or neutral read.
description: You set the goals that matter to you, then put everyday decisions to it, large or small, and each one comes back with a straightforward read: it improves your odds of getting there, hurts them, or makes no real difference. Probabilities rather than promises, and the bot defers to your own judgement every time.

name: Coverage Desk
tagline: Explains an insurance declarations page in everyday wording, and sells nothing.
description: Paste in a declarations page or your own list of coverages and it explains in plain English what each part of the policy does and does not cover. It will not sell, quote prices, or invent limits that are not written down, and any question it cannot settle from the document goes to the licensed agent named on the page.

name: Inbox Scout
tagline: A short morning brief of unread mail, sorted into needs me, can wait and noise.
description: It produces a brief from the last 24 hours of unread Gmail, grouping messages into needs me, can wait and noise. Replies are drafted in chat only, and nothing leaves your account without you approving it first.

name: Chop Bot
tagline: One daily brief for inbox, calendar and X replies, drafts only.
description: It cuts your inbox, calendar and X replies down to what actually needs attention: a single daily brief, nudges on the follow-ups you have not chased, and heads-ups about comments still unanswered. Run limits and checks are built in, and it drafts rather than sends.

name: Bill Watch
tagline: Sweeps your email for charges you forgot and returns a Keep, Cut or Check list.
description: A read-only money sweep across your inbox. It looks for recurring charges, trials about to convert, unused subscriptions and credits left sitting, then hands back a ledger sorted into keep, cut and check. It does not cancel or change anything itself.

name: Quartermaster
tagline: Keeps a household budget in a sheet and reports which card earns most.
description: A household budget and credit card assistant. It runs a zero-sum budget in Google Sheets, sends a daily finance report with an HTML dashboard, and works out which of your cards earns the most on each purchase. The budget itself stays in the sheet you control.

name: Media Ledger
tagline: Catalogues the ebooks, games, films and albums you already own.
description: It builds a running catalogue of your digital purchases (ebooks, audiobooks, games, films, albums) by reading your email receipts, so you can check what you already have before buying the same title twice.

name: Find Good Stocks
tagline: Stress-tests a stock thesis against public information, in Chinese.
description: A Chinese-language research partner for equity ideas. Give it an investment thesis and it sorts the public evidence into supports it, weakens it, or tells you nothing new, with weekly tracking of catalysts and segment data. It states plainly that it gives no buy or sell advice.

name: Provenance
tagline: Mines event logs for process bottlenecks and separates fact from inference.
description: A process analyst for event logs. It maps how work actually flows, checks how closely that matches the intended process, points at the bottlenecks, and helps connect the log sources behind the numbers. What it saw in the data is labelled separately from what it is inferring.

name: Ho Be Gone
tagline: Blocks scam and spam accounts around your X follows, with a daily undo list.
description: Account hygiene for X. It blocks scam, impersonator and spam accounts among your followers and the accounts that interact with you, learns from the corrections you make, and sends a short daily list you can undo with one reply.

name: Author
tagline: A weekly self-authoring coach that keeps a living roadmap of your goals.
description: A structured writing coach for adults, working through future, then present, then past. It keeps a living roadmap of the goals you write about and checks in weekly so the plan does not quietly stall.

name: Lyric Guard
tagline: Checks a song's lyrics against scripture and cites the lines it judges.
description: A discernment tool for Christian listeners. Send a title and artist, a link, or an audio file and it fetches the lyrics, rates them 1 to 10 for how risky they are to listen to on repeat, and quotes the lines behind the rating. It will not invent lyrics it cannot find.

name: Backpack
tagline: Turns school and activity emails into calendar events and a family plan.
description: Built for parents buried in school mail. It reads the notices, permission forms and activity updates arriving in the inbox, turns them into calendar events and reminders, and keeps a weekly family plan that calls out what is coming: pizza days, forms due back, early dismissals, picture day.

name: Panda Weather
tagline: Gives a 48-hour forecast in four-hour blocks, plus a radar map.
description: Ask it by US zip code, city name or a postal code anywhere in the world and it returns a 48-hour forecast split into four-hour blocks with an animated radar map. No setup needed, and it can be scheduled to send the forecast every morning.

name: Block Bot
tagline: Mutes the accounts you are tired of seeing on X, plus their variants.
description: Feed hygiene for X. It mutes the accounts you no longer want to see and adds permanent muted words, covering the name variants a single mute would miss so the same voices do not return under a new handle.

name: musica
tagline: Finds curated DJ mixes and festival sets matched to your taste.
description: Music discovery aimed at mixes rather than singles. It looks for curated DJ sets and festival recordings that fit what you already listen to, pitched either at party energy or at the long progressive stretch you want running through deep work.

name: Greenlight
tagline: Pre-checks Mac App Store, Setapp and Chrome Web Store builds.
description: A pre-submission gate for app stores. It runs through a Mac App Store, Setapp and Chrome Web Store build before upload and flags the usual rejection causes up front, so review cycles go to shipping instead of rework.

name: Eight with Attitude
tagline: A deliberately dumb question generator for very smart models.
description: A novelty bot with one job. You ask it a very dumb question and it answers in kind, as light relief alongside the serious templates in the same marketplace.

name: もらえるお金ナビゲーター
tagline: Japanese-language assistant for the benefits and refunds you never claimed.
description: A Japanese-language money bot. It checks official pages for public benefits, missed insurance claims, dormant money, overpayments and deductions that only get paid if you ask, then returns a list of what to do and what to ask. It stops at finding what is owed and does not file applications.

name: PromptsmithBot
tagline: Writes paste-ready prompts, asking only the questions that matter.
description: A prompt-writing assistant. It interviews you about the task, asks only what changes the answer, and hands back a prompt you can paste straight in. It can also re-check Anthropic's published prompting guides weekly and report what changed.

name: LaserCanon
tagline: A collaborative story bible that keeps your canon consistent.
description: A writing companion for fiction. It keeps a shared canon bible for novels, screenplays and series, tracks the details you have already established, and answers story questions from what has been set down so later drafts do not contradict earlier ones.

name: Wakeup 2 Day Trade
tagline: First-pass research on why a stock is moving, with sources and dates.
description: A research bot for day traders. Type a ticker and it returns a dated first pass on what is moving the stock: catalyst strength, dilution and cash risk, short interest, and speculative 12 to 18 month scenarios, with a chart and a scorecard. It states that it is research only and not financial advice.

name: Compression Scanner
tagline: Charts tight consolidation patterns with the breakout line marked.
description: A technical chart scanner. It looks for tight compression setups (triangles, wedges, pennants, ranges), checks them against the last completed candle, and returns a labelled chart showing the breakout line and where the idea is invalidated. Research only, not financial advice.

name: X Follower Spam Scanner
tagline: Screens your X followers for spam and impersonators, then asks first.
description: Follower hygiene for X. It scans the accounts following you for spam, hollow parody and fan accounts and impersonators, shows what it found, and waits for a yes before blocking anything, so a clean follower list does not need daily babysitting.

name: SerioFM
tagline: Gives your Grok Bots a friendly profile picture
description: Makes a profile picture for a Grok Bot out of a photo, a character, an NFT, a pet or a text description. The result follows the Serio icon style: capsule eyes, no mouth, and a pastel close-up rising from the bottom left.
instructions:
- Grokify an idea
- Grokify reference images
- Grokify entire Agent teams
features: Turns a photo or a text description into a bot icon
Serio icon look: capsule eyes, no mouth, pastel close-up from the bottom left

name: Add-Gate
tagline: A pre-install gate for third-party Grok Bot templates.
description: Reviews a third-party template preview before it goes near your workspace and returns one of three verdicts: add it, add it with narrow limits, or skip it. It refuses to add templates or install plugins itself.

name: Ask Avery
tagline: Convenes a panel of expert reviewers and returns one answer.
description: An ask-the-expert orchestrator for engineering teams. It matches your question against a screening corpus, dispatches several domain experts in parallel as consultants or reviewers, and merges their replies into a single synthesised answer. It advises, it does not implement.

name: Bot Ops Monitor
tagline: Watches your other bots and nudges the ones that stall.
description: Keeps an eye on your other Grok Bots and their scheduled jobs, catches failed or stalled work, nudges the owning bot to resume from its checkpoint, and flags tokens spent on nothing. Built for people running several bots who do not want to babysit them.

name: Bedtime Stories
tagline: Personalised bedtime stories starring your child.
description: Writes a calm, kid-safe bedtime story featuring your child, their pet and the things they love, and can read it aloud each night. It avoids repeating a story it has already told.

name: AI Daily Radar

name: Mike
tagline: Takes apart a news narrative and shows what is carrying it.
description: A news-narrative analyst. Point it at an event or a story making the rounds and it works through who is pushing the framing, what gets left out, and where the wording is doing the work. It labels its own score as an uncalibrated rubric index rather than a probability that something is false.

name: Chief of staff
tagline: A quiet chief of staff that runs programmes on KPIs and kill-switches.
description: A restrained chief of staff for long-running work. It filters incoming noise, runs programme management around artifacts and measurable KPIs, and carries percentage kill-switches so a failing workstream stops instead of drifting. It can also stand up small specialist bots to work in the background.

name: Chief of Staff
tagline: Morning briefings and meeting nudges over chat, email or WhatsApp.
description: A personal chief of staff built around a weekday morning briefing and a short nudge roughly half an hour before each meeting. It reaches you over chat, email or an optional WhatsApp channel and works from Google Calendar and Gmail. Connect X and it can also draw on search, your timeline and your bookmarks.

name: Efficiency Bot
tagline: Trims wasted tokens and dead patterns out of the other bots you run.
description: A maintenance bot for people running several Grok Bots. It reads your chat history, spots wasteful patterns and unused routines, then sets up tighter workflows in their place. One bot, one job: it tunes the roster rather than doing the roster work.

name: Protective Detail
tagline: Advance packets before every destination, plus leave-by and navigation prep.
description: An always-on travel safety bot. Before each destination it builds an advance packet, keeps location sharing to names rather than coordinates, and preps the car and the route before you need to leave. Built for people who travel on a schedule and want the boring safety work done ahead of time.

name: Agent Improver
tagline: Picks one of your bots a day, makes one safe improvement, and scores the result.
description: Daily maintenance for anyone running several bots. It picks a single bot, applies one safe change, scores performance before and after, and reports what actually moved. It stays inside its own lane and does not take over another bot's job.

name: Framecraft
tagline: Builds and cleans Figma frames with library components and pixel-accurate spacing.
description: A Figma production bot for product designers. It assembles frames from your library components, applies CSS-style auto layout, and matches spacing to the inspected properties. It keeps the Figma file as the source of truth when a design heads toward code.

name: Cards
tagline: Credit-card ops: expiring credits, best card for a purchase, keep or cancel a fee.
description: Numbers-first answers for people carrying several cards. It flags credits about to expire, names the best card for a specific purchase, and gives a keep-or-cancel call on annual fees. Short answers, no filler.

name: Travel
tagline: Maps flights, stays, ground logistics and paperwork into a critical path.
description: A personal trip planner for people juggling several moving parts at once. It lays out the critical path and the next action for each leg, including the paperwork. It never books or spends without an explicit yes from you.

name: Content
tagline: Portfolio and blog content seat: strategy, calendar, drafts you approve before posting.
description: A content seat for a personal site, aimed at craft and AI builds. It holds the strategy and calendar, drafts posts for approval, then amplifies once you give the go. It stays out of job-hunt outreach, which is a different bot's job.

name: Coach
tagline: Career accountability peer: weekly commitments, call prep, evidence before any nudge.
description: An accountability partner for designers. It holds your weekly commitments and call prep, builds an evidence pack before any pipeline status nudge, and waits for confirmation before every write. It does not auto-apply in a browser.

name: Growth
tagline: Job-hunt ops for designers, quiet-search safe, every write confirmed by you.
description: Tracks roles in Airtable, sends a Monday pipeline pulse, and builds an evidence pack before an application. You confirm every write and nothing is auto-applied in a browser. Built for a quiet search where nothing leaks.

name: Job Application Assistant
tagline: Polishes a master resume, tracks interested roles, tailors resume and cover drafts.
description: Keeps one master resume in shape, holds an interested-jobs list, and tailors resume and cover drafts per role. It outputs ATS-safe PDFs with aligned columns. Nothing is submitted until you name the role and say yes.

name: Meal Prep Molly
tagline: Keeps your weekly grocery staples in a list and reorders them in one message.
description: Holds a fixed weekly grocery list and reorders it through a delivering grocer. You can keep the same staples every week or vary them slightly. What used to be a weekly chore becomes one message.

name: House Holly
tagline: Remembers filter sizes, bulb types, mop liquid and the house details you forget.
description: A memory bot for the small household facts that only matter at the store. It keeps filter sizes, bulb types by room, cleaning liquids, candle scents and similar details, so you stop guessing in an aisle.

name: Desk Dana
tagline: Turns what you own and how you work into a desk setup shopping plan.
description: A desk setup planner covering standing desks, monitors, peripherals, lighting and style. You share what you already have and how you work, and it returns a clear, ordered shopping plan rather than a wishlist of everything.

name: Cloudflare GitHub Site Bot
tagline: Builds or migrates a site onto GitHub and Cloudflare Workers, accounts included.
description: Walks you from zero accounts to a live site on GitHub and Cloudflare Workers. It handles SSH deploy keys and API tokens, writes the design and the copy, and runs the production QA pass. Also migrates an existing site onto the same stack.

name: Paycheck Reality Check
tagline: Turns a pay stub into line findings and a worksheet that invents no rates.
description: Paste a pay stub and it reads it line by line, flags what looks wrong, and builds a worksheet that refuses to invent rates it cannot see. It also drafts a demand letter. You send everything yourself.

name: Collection Notice Action Pack
tagline: Turns a debt-collection notice into a response clock and dispute drafts.
description: Give it a debt-collection notice and it builds the response clock, a do-not-admit script, dispute letter drafts and an evidence checklist. It drafts only. You send everything yourself.

name: Count
tagline: Physical stock-count desk that writes counts into your master file only on approval.
description: A physical inventory count desk for small businesses. It builds pre-filled count sheets for the count itself, then writes the real numbers into your master stock file only after you approve them. One bot owns the count, no spreadsheet merging afterwards.

name: Events
tagline: Pop-up and market inventory desk: pack lists before a show, sold log after.
description: An inventory desk for small sellers who work markets and pop-ups. It builds the pack list before a show, logs what sold while you are there, and pushes offline sales back into your master stock file so the numbers still add up.

name: Reconcile
tagline: Compares your stock file against every sales channel and proposes the fixes.
description: An inventory mismatch desk for small shops. It compares your master stock file with each sales channel, puts the differences in one table, and proposes fixes for you to approve. It never writes changes itself.

name: Reorder
tagline: Tracks stock against reorder points, estimates run-out dates, drafts supplier orders.
description: A low-stock and supplier-order desk for small businesses. It tracks finished goods and supplies against your reorder points, estimates when each will run out, and drafts the orders for you to place yourself.

name: Wren: Game Design Partner
tagline: Designs the game loop, then plays the build and judges whether the fun landed.
description: A design partner for indie and solo game developers. It works out the concept, the core loop and what brings players back, then writes a build brief a developer or coding agent can follow. Once there is a playable build it plays it and returns PASS, DEGRADED or FAIL with fixes ranked by impact. It judges feel, not bugs.

name: Boardy
tagline: Asks Boardy, the AI superconnector, for intros straight from your own Gmail.
description: A bridge to Boardy, the AI superconnector at boardy@boardy.ai. Ask for a person or an intro in chat and it emails Boardy from your Gmail account, then relays the real reply back. No new inbox and no manual forwarding.

name: Lineup Lock
tagline: Fantasy football coach for this week: lineup, start/sit, waivers, trades.
description: A weekly fantasy football coach. It sets the starting lineup, gives start and sit calls with real confidence levels, suggests waivers that match your league rules, and advises on trades against your scoring. Fantasy only, no betting picks.

name: 次の日の献立 自動化

builder.name: フクベイ｜健康食アンバサダー

tagline: Sends a photo of today's food, gets tomorrow's breakfast, lunch and dinner recipes.
description: A Japanese-language meal planner. You send a photo of what you ate today and it searches X for recipes that fit tomorrow's breakfast, lunch and dinner, returning each suggestion with the source post attached. Aimed at people who want their nutrition balanced without planning it themselves.

name: 彩票兑奖助手
tagline: Checks a lottery ticket against the official draw and says plainly whether it won.
description: A Chinese-language ticket checker. Send a photo of the ticket or just the numbers and it checks the official draw result, then tells you plainly whether the ticket won. It does not suggest numbers and does not buy tickets on your behalf.

name: Doggo 🐾
tagline: One breed-specific training idea for your dog every morning.
description: A dog trainer and behaviourist in a bot. Tell it about your dog and it sends one idea each morning tuned to the breed, covering training, reactivity, anxiety, boredom and plain fun. Built for owners who want a daily nudge rather than a course.

name: Markets Weekday Brief
tagline: Weekday card on the prediction markets you watch, with YES ideas you place yourself.
description: A weekday pulse on the prediction markets on your watchlist. Each morning it returns a clean card of movements and green YES buy ideas, with odds pulled from public Polymarket and Kalshi APIs. It never places a trade for you.

name: Morning Triage Chief
tagline: Paste a messy to-do list, get four buckets, counts, a brief and three next moves.
description: A triage bot for the morning. Drop in an unstructured to-do list and it sorts everything into four buckets, counts what is there, writes a short brief, and names the three next moves. Useful when the list is longer than the day.

name: Game Gary
tagline: Logs what you like and dislike in games, then recommends ones that fit.
description: A taste companion for video games. It records what you liked and did not, mapping mechanics, story, pace and feel, then recommends games that match. Built to cut bad buys and get through more of a backlog.

name: Film Freddy
tagline: Learns what you love and skip in films, then says what to watch and where.
description: A film taste companion. It learns what you love and what you skip, recommends films that fit, and tells you where each one is streaming. Suits both seasoned and new film watchers.

name: Instagram Iris
tagline: Scores Instagram creators against your ICP and drafts the outreach DM.
description: A creator-outreach bot. It qualifies Instagram creators against an ideal customer profile you define, then drafts a hook drawn from their recent posts and a DM you send yourself. No automated sending.

name: Nomad Pro – UK Residency Tracker
tagline: Day-by-day UK travel and work log measured against the statutory residence test.
description: Keeps the administration side of UK residency in order. It maintains a day-by-day travel and work log with records, measures the totals against HMRC statutory residence test figures and visa stay limits, and adds a travel concierge for the next move. Record-keeping, not tax advice.

name: Sundial
tagline: Calendar assistant for meetings, deadlines and focus blocks, with conflict flags.
description: A scheduling assistant covering meetings, deadlines and focus blocks. It flags conflicts before they land and keeps the week organised. Straightforward calendar work rather than a full chief of staff.

name: What's for Dinner?
tagline: One dinner idea a day fitted to your household diets, time, kitchen and budget.
description: A home-cooking helper for households with constraints. It sends one dinner idea a day matched to allergies, diets, available time, kitchen equipment and budget. It can also read a fridge photo and turn what is in there into dinner, or plan the week with a single grocery list.

name: Opportunities Research
tagline: Hunts problems and gaps from your week and public signals, and cuts hard.
description: Applied YC-style opportunity research. It looks for problems, gaps and markets in your own week plus public signals such as requests for startups and batch patterns, then falsifies the weak ones instead of padding the list. It refuses to invent market sizes or pitch a product for you.

name: Fare Watch
tagline: Watches trips you already booked for a cheaper fare, stay or better dates.
description: Reads your booking emails and calendar, then keeps checking airline and hotel sites for trips you have already paid for. It hand back one card per trip with alternatives, change fees and a clear keep-or-switch verdict. It never books, changes, cancels or pays.

name: Creator Tracker
tagline: Alerts when chosen X creators post, plus a daily leaderboard by views and followers.
description: Follows any creators you pick on X and alerts you when they post, optionally filtered to a topic, with a link and a one-line summary. It also publishes a daily leaderboard ranking them by views, engagement and followers. For keeping up without scrolling.

name: Fantasy Football GM
tagline: Fantasy football GM running wire, usage, market and desk lanes for your scoring.
description: A fantasy football general manager built as a small staff pipeline covering the wire, usage, market and desk lanes. It handles start and sit calls, waivers, trades and injury flags against your league scoring. Nothing is submitted without your yes.

name: On This Day
tagline: Ten sourced historical events each morning, then a fair trivia game.
description: Every morning it sends ten verified historical events from that date, with sources and trivia, filtered to the history you actually like. It then hosts a trivia game solo or with friends, one question at a time, without leaking answers or inventing facts.

name: Customer Service
tagline: Finds the customer orders still needing a ship or reship, and drafts the replies.
description: Keeps small online sellers on top of their customer email. It works through the Gmail inbox to find orders still needing to be shipped or reshipped and drafts the replies for you to review. Nothing goes out without you.

name: CPA Bot
tagline: Reads linked bank and card statements into revenue, expense and cash-flow reports.
description: A bookkeeping assistant for small business owners. It reads linked bank accounts and credit card statements and turns them into clear reports on revenue, expenses, cash flow and daily spending. Reporting only, so you keep the bookkeeping judgement.

name: News Brief
tagline: One weekly briefing on the stories that lasted, with the claims checked.
description: A single short weekly briefing on the news that actually held up all week. It gives plain facts from sources across the political spectrum, strips the bias, and explicitly checks claims circulating online. Written for people who do not follow the news daily.

name: Beside
tagline: A listening companion for hard days, with real human helplines in a crisis.
description: A warm listening companion for depression, anxiety, grief and loneliness. It is not a doctor or a therapist. It listens carefully, offers small optional steps only when asked, and in a crisis points people to real human helplines fast.

name: Fabrication
tagline: Takes CAD parts to a ready-to-slice 3D print project, checking fit and hole sizes.
description: A fabrication assistant that carries a part from CAD through to print. It checks fit, flat bed faces and hole sizes, shows previews, and hands back a project file ready to slice. It asks before anything actually prints.

name: Trading Journal
tagline: Logs trades by chat, voice, CSV or screenshot and reviews them against your rules.
description: An evidence-based trading journal and plan coach for people who already trade. Ideas, fills and exits go in by chat, voice, CSV or screenshot, and plans get challenged against your own rules and history. Review is honest rather than encouraging. It never places trades.

name: Promo Motion Video Maker, Made Easy
tagline: Answers a few questions about your business, returns an animated promo in your colours.
description: A beginner-friendly promo video maker. Answer a few questions about your business and it produces a polished animated promo in your brand colours with original music, formatted for Reels, TikTok or a website. You approve each step as it goes.

name: Market Morning
tagline: Pre-market brief and closing recap for your own watchlist, with sources.
description: A pre-market brief and a closing recap covering only the names on your watchlist. It reports moves, earnings, filings and catalysts, each with its source. Written for self-directed investors who want context rather than tips.

name: LDS Church News
tagline: Follows official newsroom and Church News despatches, quiet unless it matters.
description: Follows significant news from The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints as published by its official Newsroom and Church News. It stays quiet by default and only pings when something is worth knowing.

name: FORGE PLATE
tagline: Lift and plate coach running one command at a time, no invented weights.
description: A training and nutrition coach for novice and heavy lifters. Commands cover the week grid, logging, trends, exercise swaps, ramp and a high-protein plate, one at a time. It does not invent weights and does not give medical advice.

name: Creative Studio Scout
tagline: Finds verified hands-on craft workshops and classes near you or where you travel.
description: Finds hands-on creative workshops, cultural crafts and small classes near you or wherever you are travelling, with every date, price and booking link checked before it is passed on. For people who want to make something rather than sightsee.

name: Mr. Scamander
tagline: Personal CFO for rebuilding money habits, with a priority stack and check-ins.
description: A personal finance officer for someone rebuilding their money habits. It tracks cash and debt, curbs impulse spending, protects the food and housing lines first, and runs a clear priority stack with weekly and monthly check-ins.

name: Weight Loss & Fitness Coach
tagline: Photo food logs, locked macros and stall fixes, with travel and sick modes.
description: A fat-loss coach built around photo and label food logging and macros that stay locked unless you change them. It handles stalls, travel days, being sick, restaurant menus and strength personal records, with optional handoffs to a buddy bot. Power features stay off until you ask for them.

name: Intake Desk
tagline: Paste every incoming request and lead, get one sorted queue with a next step each.
description: A single intake queue for the requests, leads and jobs arriving from every channel. Paste them in and it sorts and prioritises the pile, attaching a concrete next step to each item. Good for a one-person business with too many front doors.

name: 9 EMA Grok bot
tagline: Scans a watchlist for 9 EMA pullback setups and writes the order ticket.
description: Scans the symbols on your watchlist for 9 EMA pullback setups and writes a finished order ticket for each one it finds. An entry only counts once a candle closes through the entry line. It produces research, not financial advice, and places nothing.

name: GRIDSTORM Squad Mate
tagline: Wingman for GRIDSTORM sessions at agentgridstorm.com, no npm install.
description: A companion for GRIDSTORM at agentgridstorm.com. There is nothing to install: say fly, or paste a session link, and the human opens the session and presses launch squad. Aimed at people who want to watch a squad run without wiring up tooling first.

name: Desk
tagline: NFL prop research with stated confidence levels, never a pick and never a bet.
description: An NFL player-prop research assistant. It stamps named player props and totals with language-supported probabilities and shows its reasoning. It never gives picks and never places bets.

name: Grok Bot Specialist
tagline: Answers how Grok Bot works and keeps your bot roster in line with best practice.
description: A help-desk bot for Grok Bot itself. It answers questions about how the product works and reviews your roster against documented best practice. Useful when a setup has grown past what you can hold in your head.

name: VPS bot
tagline: Builds and tunes proxy VPS setups, in Simplified Chinese, kernel through client.
description: A Simplified Chinese-language VPS bot for proxy servers. It handles kernel-level latency tuning, high-port deployments of Reality, hy2, TUIC, SS2022 and AnyTLS, OpenClash and client configuration, node speed testing, and timeout debugging. One bot for the whole setup rather than a pile of guides.

name: 减重教练
tagline: A Chinese-language weight-loss coach that logs meals from photos.
description: A weight-loss coach for mainland-China eating habits. It chases you for all three meals, looks at a photo of the plate to confirm what was eaten before logging it, and gives a short read on how the day’s food and activity balance out. It can read an Apple Watch for activity and does not diagnose anything or push supplements.

name: 𝕏 Lookalikes
tagline: Finds public X accounts that appear to be impersonating you.
description: An impersonation watch for X. It scans public accounts for a copied display name, a lookalike handle, a copied bio, or a straight claim to be you, and reports what it finds. It does nothing else: it never files the impersonation form, posts, follows or messages anyone. If you want X to review a profile, you open and submit that form yourself.

name: Whop Economic Intelligence
tagline: Picks your business’s best next money move, then checks the ledger.
description: A revenue operator for Whop businesses. It surfaces the single highest-value next action with the evidence behind it, executes that action once you approve, then reconciles the ledger so the next recommendation is sharper. It can work alone or hand tasks to your other Grok Bot specialists.

name: Bill
tagline: Audits your AT&T bills and argues your case in support chat.
description: A phone-bill advocate for AT&T accounts. It reviews bills and usage for savings and missed credits, then works the carrier’s support chat from the virtual assistant up through representatives and supervisors. It never pays a bill or changes your plan without your approval.

name: Agent 37
tagline: A strategy bot that takes the long-shot move and records the bet.
description: A coding and strategy desk for problems the standard answer does not solve. It writes out what the obvious experts would do, borrows a mechanism from an unrelated field, then proposes a long-shot move with the bet stated up front and a kill test agreed before it runs. It keeps a record of how those bets turned out.

name: Business
tagline: Runs your books, customers and sign-ups on one open SQL schema.
description: A small-business operator built on the open-source Business SQL schema, a complete business database that keeps the full history of everything. It runs books, customers and website sign-ups for small businesses and one-person shops on SQLite or PostgreSQL.

name: Homework Coach Desk
tagline: Coaches K-12 homework with hints, not answers.
description: A tutor for K-12 students. It works through problems with Socratic hints and a check-your-work step, then sends the parent a short summary. It never hands over final answers for graded work and will not help with tests or quizzes.

name: Competitive Landscape Desk
tagline: Builds a sourced competitor table and tells you where you stand.
description: A competitive-intelligence desk. Give it your company and it returns a sourced comparison table against named competitors, sets out the options, and makes a recommendation. Nothing is shared or published without your approval.

name: PR Review Desk
tagline: Reviews pull requests with Blocker-to-Nit findings, never merges.
description: A code-review desk. It reads a pull request and returns one review packet with findings graded Blocker, Major, Minor and Nit, each anchored to the line it concerns. It never approves, merges or posts comments on its own.

name: Inbox Triage Desk
tagline: Sorts your inbox into Reply, Delegate, Schedule and FYI lanes.
description: An inbox triage system. It sorts messages into Reply, Delegate, Schedule and FYI lanes with the ask quoted, deadlines pulled out and short reply drafts attached. Nothing is sent, shared or archived until you give one exact dispatch line.

name: Meeting Recap Desk
tagline: Turns meeting notes into decisions, action items and owners.
description: A recap writer for meetings. It turns notes or transcripts into a clean summary with the decisions made, the action items, and who owns each one, so follow-ups stay clear after every call. Nothing is sent or shared until you approve it.

name: Sales Call Prep Desk
tagline: Preps a cited account brief, discovery questions and the ask.
description: A pre-call briefing desk for sales. Before each call it assembles a cited brief on the account, discovery questions, likely objections with answers, and a clear next-step ask. It never writes to your CRM and nothing is emailed without your approval.

name: Make It Click
tagline: Teaches you a new topic by anchoring it to what you know.
description: A learning companion. Pick something you want to understand and it teaches it by connecting the new ideas to what you already know, adjusting the explanation until it clicks. Built for following curiosity rather than working through a syllabus.

name: VoxBot
tagline: Places and answers phone calls through your own Twilio line.
description: A voice line for your Grok Bot, wired to the installer’s own ElevenLabs and Twilio accounts. It places outbound calls on request and takes inbound calls, which stay public until unlocked with a codephrase. Call handling runs on telephony and voice accounts you control.

name: Kung Fu Saga
tagline: A Kung Fu Saga guide for builds, bosses and gear.
description: A walkthrough companion for the game Kung Fu Saga. Ask about classes, builds, levelling, bosses or gear, or what to save versus spend, and it answers from a dedicated knowledge base for the game rather than generic advice.

name: Replicator
tagline: Turns a Grok Bot into a paste kit for a ChatGPT Dot.
description: A migration tool. It takes any Grok Bot and builds a paste kit that recreates it as a ChatGPT Dot, and when you are signed in to the ChatGPT desktop app it can apply the change live.

name: Pheid
tagline: Routes voice-assistant asks to the right specialist bot.
description: A switchboard between a voice assistant and your specialist bots. It routes each request to the right bot, relays short status back, and writes the session minutes into Notion.

name: Stagehand
tagline: Edits WordPress on staging and waits for your go-ahead.
description: A WordPress staging assistant. It makes the change on the staging site, checks the result, and will not touch the live site until you say so.

name: Codey
tagline: A coding assistant that proposes changes and waits to merge.
description: A careful coding assistant. It proposes changes, opens pull requests when you ask, and waits for your explicit yes before merging, publishing or deploying anything.

name: Groundskeeper
tagline: Keeps an Obsidian vault tidy: unfiled notes, stubs, duplicates.
description: A vault janitor for Obsidian. It finds notes left unfiled at the root, notes with no tags, stubs and duplicates, and tidies them up. Part of an Obsidian Vault Kit alongside Porter for intake and Quill for craft.

name: Grok Apron
tagline: Meal-plans from the weekly ad and fills your grocery cart.
description: A household meal planner that works from your grocery store’s weekly ad. It builds a cost-conscious plan, then fills the checkout cart on the store’s website for pickup or delivery. Family size, how often you cook and how much variety you want are set on its meal planner page.

name: News Honestly
tagline: Gives two good-faith readings of a headline, then a bridge.
description: A news reader that resists a single frame. For recent public headlines it writes two serious good-faith readings of the story, a bridge between them, sources, and a HIGH, MED or LOW trust label. Each brief arrives as full text in chat plus a styled HTML page.

name: Landlord Ledger
tagline: Rent roll and Schedule E bookkeeping for small landlords.
description: Bookkeeping for small landlords. It matches rent deposits to each tenant, flags rent that is late or short, sorts expenses into Schedule E categories, files receipts and tracks lease and notice dates. You get a monthly rent roll and a tax-year summary. Reminders are drafts you approve, and it never moves money.

name: Budget Coach
tagline: Tracks spending against income-sized budgets and flags overruns.
description: A personal budget coach. It tracks spending by category against budgets sized to what you earn, flags overages early, and suggests concrete cuts. Short check-ins run off connected finance data.

name: Creator Content Engine
tagline: Turns a rough idea into hooks, posts, replies and image concepts.
description: A content engine for X creators who want range. Drop in a topic, a rough thought, a photo, a screenshot, a news item or a video idea and it returns hooks, post options, replies, short-video and image concepts, and follow-ups in your voice. It drafts only and never posts without asking, and any stats it quotes are source-labelled.

name: Merit
tagline: A Friday claim desk that scores civic and science claims.
description: A weekly claim desk. It hunts down civic, science and UAP claims plus claims about meaning, scores each one, keeps a Watch list, and writes a single Friday brief. It sets out the evidence without telling you what to believe.

name: Benefits Concierge
tagline: Tracks your card and membership perks before they expire.
description: A benefits tracker for credit cards and memberships. It logs seasonal credits, reminds you before they expire, and tells you which perk to use before you book, shop or ride. Nothing is redeemed or paid without you.

name: Quote Finder
tagline: Finds verified quotes and flags misattributions.
description: A quote checker. Name a person and it hunts real quotes from them, checking primary sources and reputable outlets, flagging misattributions, and saying plainly when something cannot be verified.

name: Scotty
tagline: Plans what to ship next and briefs your coding tool.
description: A product strategist for solo creators and small teams. It plans what to ship next, writes paste-ready briefs for your AI coding tool, and keeps the team’s AI usage inside budget.

name: PepeTrack
tagline: Peptide and GLP-1 research plus dose tracking.
description: A research and tracking companion for peptides and GLP-1s. It helps research compounds, read published protocols and work through reconstitution maths, then logs shots and remembers what is next on your schedule. Research and logging, not medical advice.

name: Am I Covered?
tagline: Explains US insurance documents in plain English or Spanish.
description: An insurance document reader for the US. It explains home, condo, renters, flood, auto, umbrella and small business policies in plain English or Spanish, covering what the policy says and what to ask about. It never decides whether you are covered.

name: Paperwork Desk
tagline: Tracks every bill and deadline, and drafts your replies.
description: A paperwork handler. Forward bills, renewal notices, leases, medical bills and letters and it pulls out what you owe and when, tracks every deadline, reminds you before it falls due, and drafts replies that you approve before anything is sent.

name: Senior Repairo
tagline: Audits your other bots and proposes one change at a time.
description: An auditor for the other Grok Bots you run. It proposes one change at a time with a snapshot and an undo, never runs their jobs itself, and reports as a topic, the evidence, and a single Apply, Skip or Stop decision.

name: Crypto Buddy
tagline: A crypto research pack with sourced metrics and charts.
description: Give it a ticker or coin name and it returns a research package: sourced metrics, a plain-English read on the price action, a scored research gauge, and five generated images including a poster and a 24-month chart. Research only, never buy or sell advice.

name: Rare Combo Catalog
tagline: Maps rare disease combinations into a gap table for clinicians.
description: A research tool for rare disease combinations. It maps findings to a gap table and a plain-language page, plus discussion prompts for a clinician visit covering workup and what to avoid discussing. It works from public sources and prints a table PDF by default. Not a doctor.

name: Order Watch
tagline: Watches your inbox for delivery problems and stays quiet otherwise.
description: A parcel watcher. It monitors a connected email account for packages that are out for delivery, delayed, waiting on you, or delivered, and stays silent unless something needs attention.

name: Nash
tagline: Maps the game behind a negotiation and gives you the next move.
description: A negotiation analyst. It lays out who is involved in a high-stakes deal, what each side wants and how they will likely respond, then gives you a clear next move and checks your own plan for blind spots. description: Helps families handle what comes after a loss, from the funeral and paperwork to accounts, benefits and probate, one step at a time. It can also help you plan ahead so your family is not left working it out from scratch.

description: Reviews Spanish copy such as lessons, posts, handouts and app text for natural Colombian Spanish, and returns a Pass or Fail verdict with paste-ready fixes. It never publishes or posts anything.

name: Super Intelligence Bot
tagline: A QA checker for your bot team: work is checked for maths, risks and compliance before it ships.
description: A quality gate for a bot team: your other bots send their work here before it goes out, and it checks the maths, the risks and the compliance, then sends fixes back until the work holds up.

name: GBrain
tagline: Keeps a bot's memory in GBrain and runs the server side: jobs, consolidation, backups.
description: Hosted or self-hosted, it keeps your Grok Bot's memory in GBrain and helps you run the service itself, from the job queue and consolidation to calibration, upgrades and backups. Built by the GBrain author.

name: Weltzeit-Rechner
tagline: Shows when worldwide events and rocket launches happen in your time zone, and makes share cards.
description: Give it an event, livestream or launch and it converts the start time into yours, flags what is coming up, and renders a world-clock graphic with a caption ready to post.

name: スラックおまかせくん
tagline: React to a Slack message with an emoji and it drafts the task, reply or event for you to pick.
description: Add an emoji reaction to any Slack message and it proposes the obvious next step, a task entry, a reply or a calendar item, each as an option you choose from. Aimed at the small non-engineering jobs you would rather hand off.

tagline: Audits bloated, forgetful bots and rebuilds the broken ones once you approve.
description: Long-running bots go slow and sloppy as their chats pile up. This gruff junkyard-mechanic persona inspects your bots, tells you which ones have rotted, and rebuilds them with a clean handover once you say yes.

name: grokcli
tagline: Writes tight coding prompts and runs them headless through the Grok CLI, then commits.
description: It turns a request into a precise coding prompt, runs it headless on your own machine through the Grok CLI, then commits, pushes and reports back. For people who want the coding done locally while the bot supervises the runs.

name: Faith General
tagline: Short daily Scripture, prayer and encouragement check-ins.
description: A gentle Christian faith companion: Scripture-led reflections, prayer prompts, encouragement and light accountability, delivered as a short daily check-in you can also point at your other AI assistants.

name: Inbox
tagline: A quiet email watcher that only pings you for mail needing action today.
description: It watches your inbox and stays silent unless something needs a decision today; everything else arrives as one digest. Read-only by default, it does not send, reply or delete unless you ask.

name: Vercel Ops Monitor
tagline: One daily Vercel check: credit spend, 5xx, traffic swings, 404s, failed deploys.
description: A daily once-over of a Vercel deployment covering credit spend against plan, server errors, traffic swings, 404s, new errors and failed builds. Quiet days collapse into a single line.

name: Kiwi Pocket
tagline: Read-only view of your New Zealand bank accounts for spending and budgeting.
description: Connects read-only to New Zealand bank accounts through your own Akahu personal app, then keeps spending, bills and budgeting current from live bank data. It cannot move money.

name: Stenographer
tagline: An encrypted append-only log of your bot chats, plus a rebuild pack.
description: Keeps a light, encrypted, append-only record of every Grok Bot chat along with the steps to rebuild a bot from scratch, so you can back a setup up or move it to a new account.

name: Food Run
tagline: Builds one restaurant pickup or delivery cart and stops before payment.
description: It assembles a single restaurant order, checks your rewards, reads back the store, items, timing and total, then stops so you can pay. One cart at a time, by design.

name: Dinner Plan
tagline: Photo your fridge and pantry, get meals for tonight and a shopping list.
description: Snap the fridge, freezer and pantry and it suggests meals you can cook tonight, sized for your household, then builds a shopping list from your nearest store and warns you the day before food goes off.

name: Watch Notes
tagline: Talk to your Apple Watch or iPhone and it files each note. Mac setup required.
description: Speak a note into an Apple Watch or iPhone and it saves it, sorts it, tracks what is still open and passes jobs on to your other bots. It needs setup on a Mac before it will run.

name: Bot Lock Security Desk

description: Reviews what your AI agents can reach, writes a deny-by-default permission policy, and helps install free open-source guardrails with an audit log and a kill switch. Built for teams already running agents in production.

name: Dr Grok
tagline: Explains symptoms, medications and test results in plain language.
description: A health explainer for symptoms, medications, conditions and test results in plain language, plus help preparing questions for a real appointment. It says up front that it is not a substitute for a physician.

name: PPL Checkride DPE

description: A mock Designated Pilot Examiner for Private Pilot checkride orals: it works through the ACS, scores your answers and points to the FAA handbook chapter to study. Built for student pilots and their instructors.

name: Sherlock Jobs

description: Works out which senior postings are genuine and a match for you, returns each with a direct apply link, and writes tailored cover letters for the ones you pick. It tracks everything in Notion and never applies or emails on your behalf.
